dimensions.name: Agent Interface & Operability
dimensions.interpretation: Integrated instructions, bootstrap and validation; a completed compliant agent PR path was not demonstrated.

dimensions.name: Automation Coverage for Routine Maintenance
dimensions.interpretation: Machine-triggered workflow chaining and verified deduplication; unattended maintenance through accepted PR remains unproven.

dimensions.name: Self-Healing CI/CD
dimensions.interpretation: Two repair classes and recovery were observed; the rubric still caps this at 3 because its static rollback-path signal is false.

dimensions.name: Continuous Improvement Loops
dimensions.interpretation: Repeatable audits and proof of fix; the panel did not establish governed rule promotion or measurable learning gains.

dimensions.name: Agent Execution Surfaces
dimensions.interpretation: Skills plus MCP configuration establish the deterministic floor of 3; no hosted or hostile-source isolation claim.

dimensions.name: Policy, Safety, and Change Guardrails
dimensions.interpretation: Live rulesets, reviews, pinned actions and bounded execution; autonomous policy closure remains unproven.

dimensions.name: Observability of Agentic Work
dimensions.interpretation: Verified local origin correlation, lifecycle outcomes, machine completion, consumption, stale and duplicate handling.

dimensions.name: Human-on-the-Loop Integration
dimensions.interpretation: Enforced human review, owner approval and escalation; a compliant agent PR acceptance lifecycle remains unproven.

dimensions.name: Agentic Change Throughput & Contributor Mix
dimensions.interpretation: The 90-day API window detected zero agent-authored merged PRs; co-authorship metadata alone did not prove material throughput.
